title: Custom Football Helmet on American Flag Vintage Comforter
description:
Transform your space with this sports-themed football bedding set from Jeminise. Perfect for football players, fans, and coaches, this comforter set adds a cool, athletic touch to any bedroom or boys' room decor. It is designed to offer a super soft feel and a layer of breathable warmth, making it a thoughtful gift for birthdays, holidays, or special celebrations.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Features custom options with text inputs to personalize with a name or number.
  • Product Type Options: Available as either a lightweight duvet cover (designed to be paired with an insert) or a cozy, thicker comforter with a soft microfiber filling.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling to prevent clumping or shifting.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in Twin (68x88 or 68x90 inches), Full (78x88 or 79x90 inches), Queen (88x88 or 90x90 inches), and King (104x88 or 104x90 inches).
  • Included Components: Includes 1 Duvet Cover (or Comforter) with optional matching pillowcases and flat sheet covers.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water, tumble dry on low heat, and quick-drying.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Set
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester
Fill Material Microfiber
Selected Design Vintage Football Helmet
Theme Football
Pattern Football Helmet
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine wash with cold water, Tumble dry on low heat, Iron on low/medium heat
